articles.title: Germany Wants to Lead the World in Industrial AI: How NVIDIA Will Help
articles.body_text: In the cavernous hall of Kraftwerk, a former power station in Berlin, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang sat down to discuss Germany’s AI roadmap, and in particular, the industrial applications of AI.
